title: Mixed configuration spaces, fixed points and Loop braid groups
summary: We introduce the notion of mixed configuration spaces of the $3$-ball. That is, we consider both distinct circles and distinct points in the interior of the $3$-ball and we prove that the projection onto the configuration space of circles of the $3$-ball is a locally trivial fibration. The key idea for defining the mixed configuration spaces is to study fixed points of orientation-preserving homeomorphism of the $3$-ball that leave invariant a trivial link of $n$ components in the interior of the $3$-ball.
